subject: Request: SOC 2 artifacts + privileged access recertification minutes & bridge letter
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@vanguardhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, procurement@vanguardhealth.com
Date: Sun, 19 Sep 2027 16:02:00 -0400
Subject: SOC2 Type II + supplemental artifacts request (audit window clarification)

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. As part of Vanguard Health's procurement review for our platform controls we need a few items to complete our SOC2 and vendor risk evaluation. We received the SOC 2 Type II report on file, but we need two clarifications and a short bundle of supporting artifacts that are not included in the narrative: 

1) Audit period/bridge: Please confirm the SOC2 audit window (report indicates period ended 2027-06-30). Can you provide a bridge letter that confirms there have been no control changes material to the report since that date and, if relevant, the date range that the bridge covers?

2) MFA enforcement slices: We require an extract showing enforcement events for interactive user logins (success/failure) and admin/privileged bypass events for the last 90 days. CSV or Syslog slice is fine; we will provide a schema.

3) Privileged access recertification: We need minutes or an attestation from the most recent privileged access recertification (Q3 2027). Minutes, attendance, and an outline of any remediation actions are preferred.

4) Privileged session recordings / audit: For a small sample (up to 5 sessions) of privileged admin activity in July–August 2027, can you provide the archived session metadata and redacted recordings or the command audit trail?

Target date: can you confirm whether these items can be delivered by end of week (2027-09-23)? We may accept redacted or sampled outputs; we just need enough for our controls team to validate.

If there are any managed service constraints or PII restrictions, flag them and we'll propose acceptable redaction. CCing procurement and your internal security team for coordination.

Thanks —
Marta Lopez
Sr. Information Security Manager, Vanguard Health
M: +1 617-555-0187
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@vanguardhealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 19 Sep 2027 18:24:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SOC2 Type II + supplemental artifacts request (audit window clarification)

Marta —

Thanks for the clear list. We can support all four items but want to confirm scope so we deliver exactly what your controls team needs. Quick answers up front: yes, the SOC 2 Type II report covers the period ending 2027-06-30; we can provide a bridge letter covering 2027-07-01 through 2027-09-30 with the usual attestation language (no material control changes). We will send a draft for signature.

For the artifact slices: 
- MFA enforcement: we can provide a CSV slice (timestamp, user_id, event_type, outcome, source_ip, client_id) for the 90-day window you requested. We will redact usernames to pseudonyms if needed and include a key mapping file under NDA if you require identity mapping.
- Privileged recert minutes: we can extract the official meeting minutes and attestation PDF from our governance repo. That will include attendees, decisions, and follow-ups.
- Privileged session audit: we cannot export raw video recordings to external parties without a controlled transfer; however, we can provide redacted audit trails (command history and timestamps) and a small set of redacted screen captures for the selected sessions.

Next steps: Olga (cc) will propose the exact extraction windows and a delivery plan by tomorrow. If that works, we'll aim to deliver the CSV + minutes + redacted session artifacts and the bridge letter draft by 2027-09-22 for your review. Does that timeline meet your procurement deadline?

Soojin Lee
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0104

Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com

Subject: Re: SOC2 Type II + supplemental artifacts request (audit window clarification)

Hi Marta / team —

I pulled the extraction plan together. Details below and included as an attachment (mfa-log-extraction-plan-20270920.txt). We will deliver samples, not live streams. Delivery proposal:

- MFA slice: window 2027-06-23 -> 2027-09-23 (90 days). Output format CSV, UTF-8, fields: event_ts, pseudonym_user_id, event_type (login, mfa_challenge, mfa_bypass, admin_override), result (success/failure), auth_method, source_ip, client_id, session_id. Expected size ~45k events; we will provide the first 5k rows as the sample and a summary aggregate for the full window.

- Privileged recertification minutes: we will provide the official PDF minutes for the Q3 2027 recert session, attendance roster (redacted emails), and any open remediation tickets exported from JIRA (ids only, no content). File: privileged-recert-minutes-Q3-2027.pdf

- Privileged session audit: we will export the audit trail for up to 5 sessions (July–Aug 2027). Export will include timestamped command/event lines, session_id, pseudonym_user_id, and redacted screenshots where relevant. Due to retention policy we cannot export raw keystroke-level captures older than 180 days without legal approval — the selected sessions fall inside retention.

- Bridge letter: we'll attach a draft (bridge-draft-sept2027.docx). It will state audit period 2026-07-01 to 2027-06-30 and provide a coverage attestation for 2027-07-01 through 2027-09-30. Legal will need to sign; can you confirm who at Vanguard will sign? We can upload to DocuSign (link below) once you confirm.

ATTACHMENTS (stubs):
- soc2-type2-20270630.pdf (already provided to procurement)
- mfa-log-sample-20270922.csv (sample extract)
- privileged-recert-minutes-Q3-2027.pdf
- bridge-draft-sept2027.docx

Privacy & redaction notes: we will pseudonymize internal user IDs and remove any patient/customer identifiers. If you require mapping to real identities we can provide that under an NDA/specific data transfer agreement.

Planned delivery date: 2027-09-22 (sample CSV + recert minutes + draft bridge). Let me know if you need a narrower slice or different formats.

Thanks —
Olga Petrov
Technical Compliance Engineer | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com

Thanks, Soojin and Olga — this plan looks good and meets our controls team needs. A couple quick items: 

- The 2027-09-22 delivery timeline is acceptable. Please include the sample CSV (first 5k rows) and the Q3 minutes.
- For the bridge letter, Vanguard will require a signed letter with a named Redwood signatory and corporate letterhead. Can you route the DocuSign to me (Marta Lopez) and to our legal contact procurement@vanguardhealth.com?
- We accept the pseudonymization approach; please include a short write-up of your redaction steps in the delivery packet.

If you encounter any legal or export constraints on the session artifacts, flag them and we'll decide whether a remote review can suffice. Otherwise, please proceed and send the DocuSign link when ready.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Marta
